items.name: Retro-gaming Raspberry Pi system in SUPERPi CASE
items.variant: Owner thinks Raspberry Pi 3 with 2 GB RAM; Pi model and RAM unverified
interfaces: Front case Power / Eject / Reset controls
items.notes: One grey SNES-inspired SUPERPi CASE with 'RETROFLAG FOR ALL OF US' branding photographed. Owner says a Raspberry Pi is installed and the machine is currently set up for retro gaming; user tentatively recalls 'raspberry pi 3 2G'. Board is NOT visible. Official Raspberry Pi 3 Model B/B+ RAM is 1 GB, so the stated 2 GB may reflect another board or mistaken recollection; do not claim verified Pi 3 or 2 GB. Treat case plus internally reported Raspberry Pi as one assembled device, not two separate inventory units. Operating system/emulator distribution and operational condition have not been observed. References: https://www.raspberrypi.com/products/raspberry-pi-3-model-b/ ; https://www.raspberrypi.com/products/raspberry-pi-3-model-b-plus/ .
